Sub: Forwarding of details in respect of International Workers deployed in
India — Regarding.

Sir,

Instructions have been issued from time to time regarding compliance
in respect of International Workers employed in covered establishments.
Special provisions relating to International Workers have been notified vide
gazette notification 01.10.2008, suitably amending the EPF Scheme, 1952
and Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995. As on date, bilateral agreements
relating to Social Security have been implemented in respect of two
countries namely, Belgium (w.e.f. 01.09.2009) and Germany (w.e.f.
01.10.2009). Negotiations are in progress with other countries.

It is expected that the employers of covered establishments are
complying with the statutory provisions pertaining to International Workers
and depositing contributions on full salary of the International Workers.
Subsequent to the implementation of the Agreements with Belgium and
Germany, the employees from these two countries may have sought
exemption from contributing to the Indian Social Security System on the
basis of certificate of coverage/detachment certificate issued by the
respective competent body/agency. This certificate of coverage issued to an
International Worker confers on him the status of excluded employee,
whereby he continues to contribute to the Social Security System of his
country, and is exempted from contributing to the Indian Social Security
System.
